open_points.subject: add_captured_trial_case
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - add_captured_trial_case: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] Only after every check passed, each spooled file's bytes are read with read_value_bytes from its spool source and published with put_value_bytes; every input becomes a StoredValue with the stored schema of its contract input port (M21) and the class that port declares, values keeping their value_digest and files becoming file-carriage StoredValues for the copied digests; inputs MUST list the refs as add_trial_case does, in port name order by Unicode code point, a many file port's refs one per file consecutive in list order; the case has no expected outputs, origin captured and captured_from the given source.
open_points.question: PortRef permits FileFactsRef, but FileFactsRef contains facts only and has no source from which the required bytes can be read and copied; must FileFactsRef be excluded or refused here, or must a readable byte source be added for it?

open_points.subject: execute_trial_case inputs
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - execute_trial_case: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST read the case's input bytes with read_value_bytes, build one PortPayload per input port, a FileListPayload in list order for a many file port, and call execute_function once with the implementation code, the contract version's ports and its resource bounds.
open_points.question: A TrialCase input may now be a FileFactsRef, but that variant has no readable byte source, while execute_trial_case requires bytes for every input; must TrialCase inputs exclude FileFactsRef, or must the prompt define how its bytes are obtained?

open_points.subject: execute_trial_case expected outputs
open_points.text: - PortRef discriminated union on field 'ref_kind' (exact variants, no others exist): StoredValuesRef (ref_kind='stored_values'), SpooledFilesRef (ref_kind='spooled_files'), FileFactsRef (ref_kind='file_facts'); a value of PortRef is an instance of one of these variants, never of another model, and PortRef itself is not constructed
open_points.other_text: - execute_trial_case: [BEHAVIOR] The outcome is the sandbox outcome of the same name; a succeeded execution is passed when the case has no expected outputs or every output's digest equals the expected one — every digest compared is content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes: a value output's its canonical bytes, a file output's the bytes of its FilePayload content or of each FileListPayload contents item in list order — the same digest its FileFacts later records as content_digest —, both computed from what the sandbox returned, and an expected output's the value_digest of its StoredValue, read with read_records, for a value and for each file alike; the outcome is decided before any output is written, so no output is read back from the store —, a many file output equal only with the same length and equal digests position by position, and output_mismatch otherwise; a succeeded value output whose canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant makes the outcome contract_violation.
open_points.question: TrialCase.expected_outputs may contain SpooledFilesRef or FileFactsRef, but the comparison rule requires every expected output to resolve to a StoredValue and use its value_digest; must expected outputs be restricted to StoredValuesRef, or must comparison behavior be supplied for the other variants?
